scope: Pinned VCS phase-local formula rows and elemental abundance support routines

implemented.element_order: Phase and Solution element index APIs preserve the declared canonical order
implemented.phase_formula_matrix: Translated vcs_VolPhase::transferElementsFM atom, electron-charge, and charge-neutrality rows
implemented.vcs_elab: Translated species-by-element abundance accumulation, excluding interfacial-voltage unknowns
implemented.vcs_elabcheck: Translated active-row handling, component/full bounds, 1e-12 ordinary relative check, charge-neutrality error, 1e-140 minor cutoff, and mixed-sign scaled tolerance

limitations: No pinned native differential probe directly exercised vcs_elab or vcs_elabcheck; tests cover source-derived cases.
Component-basis selection, stoichiometric reaction construction, deleted-species management, and the VCS active-set equilibrium loop remain unported.
Regression success does not certify full Cantera equivalence.
